info.description: Vescrow Escrow Backend API Service with Authentication, Wallets, and Escrows.
info.title: Vescrow API

get.description: Retrieves a list of submitted KYC documents, with optional status filtering.

parameters.description: Filter by document status (pending, approved, rejected)
parameters.name: status

200.description: Returns list of kyc document submissions preloaded with user details

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific KYC document submission by its ID, including the decrypted document number.

200.description: Returns detailed submission record with decrypted PII

put.description: Approves a user's pending KYC submission, promoting the user's KYC tier based on the document type, and logs audit.

200.description: Returns upgraded user tier and document status

put.description: Rejects a user's pending KYC submission, requiring a mandatory rejection reason, updates status, and logs audit.

post.description: Allows a logged-in user to change their password after validating their current password.
Initiates password recovery. Generates a password reset OTP and sends it (mocked). Always returns 200 OK to prevent email enumeration.
Validates user credentials (email and password), logs login event to audit trail, and returns an access token. Sets the refresh token as an HTTP-only secure cookie.

200.description: Returns access_token in body and refresh_token in HttpOnly cookie

post.description: Invalidates the current session by clearing the refresh token cookie.

get.description: Retrieves the profile details of the currently authenticated user. PII fields (email, phone) are masked in the response.

put.description: Updates the allowed profile fields (name, avatar_url) of the authenticated user.

post.description: Uses the refresh token from the HTTP-only cookie to generate and return a new access token and refresh token pair.

200.description: Returns new access_token in body and refresh_token in HttpOnly cookie

post.description: Registers a new user with default 'user' role and KYC tier. Automatically creates a default 'seller' wallet and logs a USER_REGISTERED event in the audit trail.
Generates and resends a new 6-digit OTP to the specified target (email or phone).
Completes password recovery by validating the password reset OTP and updating the user's password.
Verifies user email using the 6-digit OTP sent to their email. Marks email_verified as true and upgrades user to KYC Tier 1.
Verifies user phone number using the 6-digit OTP sent to their phone.

get.description: User sees disputes on their escrows. Admin sees all disputes with optional status filter.

post.description: Buyer opens a dispute on a delivered escrow. Escrow status transitions to 'disputed' and funds are locked.

get.description: Retrieves full details of a dispute including evidence and comments. Access restricted to escrow participants and admins.

post.description: Buyer, seller, or admin can post a comment to the dispute discussion thread.
Buyer or seller uploads evidence (file URL, type, description) to support their case.

put.description: Admin resolves the dispute as full_refund, full_release, or partial_split. Triggers wallet operations and creates audit log.

post.description: Seller submits a written response to the buyer's dispute. Dispute status transitions to 'seller_responded'.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of escrows where the authenticated user is either the buyer or the seller. Can filter by role and status.

post.description: Allows a buyer (Tier 1 KYC or higher required) to create an escrow transaction in draft state with the seller details.

get.description: Retrieves the full details of an escrow transaction. Access is restricted to participants (buyer/seller) or admins.

put.description: Allows the creator of the escrow (buyer) to edit terms (title, description, amount, inspection period) while still in draft state.

delete.description: Enables the buyer to cancel the transaction. Only valid if the escrow is in draft, pending_acceptance, or accepted states (pre-funding).

put.description: Designated seller accepts the proposed terms. Status transitions to accepted.
Buyer verifies delivery proof and completes the escrow, releasing funds to the seller's wallet. Status transitions to completed.
put.summary: Buyer approves delivery and releases funds

put.description: Seller completes job, uploads optional proof link, and marks transaction as delivered. Status transitions to delivered.
Buyer disputes delivery within the inspection period, halting payout. Status transitions to disputed.
Buyer requests additional days to inspect the delivered items.

post.description: Simulates transaction funding from the buyer side, locking escrow amount. Status transitions to funded.

get.description: Retrieves chat logs/messages related to this escrow transaction. Access restricted to participants.

post.description: Posts a new message in the chat log. Only allowed for escrow participants.

get.description: Retrieves list of milestones for the given escrow. Access restricted to participants or admins.

put.description: Seller marks the specified milestone as complete. Status updates to completed.
Designated seller rejects the proposed terms. Status transitions to rejected.
Buyer submits draft terms to the designated seller for review. Status changes to pending_acceptance.
put.summary: Submit escrow terms to the seller

get.description: Retrieves the user's current KYC tier, status, linked BVN/NIN info, and submitted document statuses.

post.description: Saves uploaded identification document details, encrypts the document number, and updates user KYC status to pending.

parameters.description: Type of document (passport, drivers_license, national_id, utility_bill, cac_cert)
parameters.name: document_type

parameters.description: Uploaded Selfie image file (optional, required for tier 3)
parameters.name: selfie_file

post.description: Verifies the format of the user's BVN, checks for duplicate linkages, encrypts and links it to the profile, and upgrades the user's KYC tier/status.
Verifies the format of the user's NIN, checks for duplicate linkages, encrypts and links it to the profile, and upgrades the user's KYC tier/status.
Initiates a payment for an accepted escrow contract and returns the Paystack authorization URL.

get.description: Manually polls and verifies the status of a payment using its reference on Paystack.

post.description: Processes real-time webhook events sent by Paystack (verifies HMAC signatures).

get.description: Retrieves the balance, currency, and frozen status of the authenticated user's primary seller wallet.
Retrieves the list of supported Nigerian banks from Paystack.
Retrieves a paginated list of ledger entries for the user's primary wallet, sorted by created_at DESC.

200.description: Returns paginated list of ledger entries

post.description: Resolves a bank account number and bank code via Paystack API to confirm the account name.
Initiates a bank payout request. Validates tier limits, sufficient balance, 24h cooldown on first withdrawal, debits wallet and creates pending payout record. Requires KYC Tier >= 1.

200.description: Returns the created pending withdrawal record

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of withdrawal requests submitted by the authenticated user, ordered by created_at DESC.

message.example: KYC document submitted successfully. Awaiting admin approval.

BearerAuth.description: Paste your raw JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
